scientific_question: Does the independently validated v175 minimal shared geometry selector transfer without refitting or result-dependent switching to one result-unopened PoolFire stopping-validation condition, while preserving fixed H1-K0 accuracy against its own selected-subset Zero-CGLS K4 reference and defeating three frozen cheap controls?
role: one-shot cross-condition gate on a result-unopened PoolFire stopping-validation trajectory under the already opened reported-calibration straight-ray proxy; not a new data family, untouched test, real BOST, curved-ray, resource, or broad external-generalization evidence
physical_hypothesis: A geometry-to-conditioning relation that is not specific to the nine opened reconstructed fields should select five-camera subsets that remain safe when the three-dimensional field morphology is replaced by the frozen PoolFire p22-s01 stopping-validation trajectory.

result_unopened_input.scientific_status_before_v176: derived pair metadata and hashes were prepared and audited previously, but no p22-s01 truth values, metrics, images, candidate outcomes, tails, or decisions were consumed to design v176
result_unopened_input.truth_gauge: per-frame spatial mean zero in the prepared pair
result_unopened_input.truth_transform: transpose each (x,y,z)=(16,16,32) frame to (z,y,x)=(32,16,16), subtract the supported-interior mean, and apply the same one-voxel outer boundary support as the calibrated proxy operator

fit_before_truth_barrier.development_source: all nine opened reconstructed fields, all thirteen opened calibrations, all four opened times, and all 126 five-camera candidates from the sealed v170/v171 evidence
fit_before_truth_barrier.primary_target: for each calibration and candidate, log maximum normalized metric over all nine development fields, all four development times, and the three frozen physical metrics
fit_before_truth_barrier.primary_model: one shared scalar Gram-ridge risk ranker with 356 geometry features, unpenalized intercept, population-standardized active columns, standard-deviation floor 1e-12, and ridge lambda 0.01
fit_before_truth_barrier.primary_selection: minimum predicted log risk per reported calibration; exact ties choose the lowest canonical subset index
fit_before_truth_barrier.fit_static_control: one global five-camera subset minimizing worst then mean development log risk over all thirteen calibrations
fit_before_truth_barrier.ray_axis_control: per-calibration world-ray-axis maximin selection with minimum then mean pair separation and canonical-index tie break

evaluation.observation: generated after FIT_READY by the exact calibrated straight-ray proxy on each fixed selected subset; prepared p22 observations.npy is never used
evaluation.candidate: DCT1023 H1 fixed-0.03 initializer at K0
evaluation.reference: Zero-CGLS K4 on the same selected subset

exact_call_ledger.offline_truth_observation: one forward per unique fixed subset and scored calibration-frame cell; excluded from logical deployment calls and explicitly reported
exact_call_ledger.resource_claim: none; no fresh wall or RSS gate is run in v176

matched_reference_gate.scope: each policy candidate is compared only with Zero-CGLS K4 on its own selected subset

independent_recomputation.fit: independent v170 metrics and v171 geometry features; augmented least-squares ridge rather than formal normal equations
independent_recomputation.truth: independently verify receipt, manifest, READY, checksums, frame roster, finite float64 shape, and reapply the xyz-to-zyx support/gauge transform
independent_recomputation.operator: independent calibrated ray construction and sparse row builder with exact adjoint check
independent_recomputation.dct_basis: analytic tensor-product cosine basis rather than formal scipy idct basis
required_checks: all parent and p22 input identities
independent frozen selections exactly match formal FIT_READY selections
FIT_READY predates the formal p22 truth-open receipt
13 calibrations x 4 frames x 8 arms and exact A/A^T receipts
camera permutation invariance and adjoint identity
primary physical fields, residuals, and three metrics
all calibration and frame absolute tails
all calibration and frame own-reference matched tails

decision_order: Any identity, fit-before-truth, truth-shape, transform, operator, solve, call-accounting, numeric, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v176 inconclusive.

If the minimal shared selector fails any strict cell, whole-calibration, four-frame, absolute, or own-reference matched gate, conclude FAIL_RESULT_UNOPENED_POOLFIRE_CONDITION_PARITY_V176 and close current selector transfer without parameter tuning.

If the primary passes but any fit-static, v169 low-mode D-opt, or ray-axis maximin control also passes, conclude FAIL_CHEAP_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_POOLFIRE_CONDITION_V176 and do not claim learned-selector advantage.
Only if the primary passes all gates, all three controls fail, exact-call receipts agree, and independent recomputation passes may v176 conclude PASS_RESULT_UNOPENED_POOLFIRE_CONDITION_V176.

A pass is one result-unopened PoolFire stopping-validation condition under the controlled straight-ray proxy. It is not broad external generalization, untouched test evidence, real BOST, curved-ray validation, resource speedup, algorithm breakthrough, or paper success.
stop_rule: A primary failure closes the current selector transfer; a cheap-control pass closes the selector-advantage claim. Neither outcome authorizes parameter tuning, a larger model, GPU rental, or opening PoolFire test trajectories.
